    (hS : IsSVDDiag S) (k : ℕ) :
    frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc S hS k)) =
    ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
      if ¬((i : ℕ) < k) ∧ (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0

name: TubalTensor.KM_ringEquiv_canonical
statement:

name: TubalTensor.canonical_starM_coord

    (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) :
    starM (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) a b i = a i * b i

name: TubalTensor.canonical_unitTube_coord

name: TubalTensor.stdBasis_mul_canonical
statement:
theorem stdBasis_mul_canonical (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    starM (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) (fun k => if k = i then 1 else 0) a =
    fun j => a i * (if j = i then 1 else 0)

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_moorePenrose
statement:
theorem weakInvM_moorePenrose (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    starM td (starM td a (weakInvM td a)) a = a ∧
    starM td (starM td (weakInvM td a) a) (weakInvM td a) = weakInvM td a ∧
    starConjM td (starM td a (weakInvM td a)) = starM td a (weakInvM td a) ∧
    starConjM td (starM td (weakInvM td a) a) = starM td (weakInvM td a) a ∧
    (∀ y : Fin n → ℝ,
      starM td (starM td a y) a = a →
      starM td (starM td y a) y = y →
      starConjM td (starM td a y) = starM td a y →
      starConjM td (starM td y a) = starM td y a →
      y = weakInvM td a)

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_mp1

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_mp3

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_mp4

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_unique
statement:
theorem weakInvM_unique (td : TubalData n) (a y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h1 : starM td (starM td a y) a = a)
    (h2 : starM td (starM td y a) y = y)
    (h3 : starConjM td (starM td a y) = starM td a y)
    (h4 : starConjM td (starM td y a) = starM td y a) :
    y = weakInvM td a

name: TubalTensor.matrix_svd_paired
statement:
theorem matrix_svd_paired {n : ℕ} (td : TubalData n) (m p : ℕ)
    (Ahat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hpaired : ∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Ahat k i j)) :
    ∃ (Uhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
      (Shat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
      (Vhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ),
      (∀ k, IsUnitary (Uhat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsUnitary (Vhat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsSVDDiagC (Shat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, Ahat k = Uhat k * Shat k * (Vhat k)ᴴ) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Uhat k i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Shat k i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Vhat k i j))
